label: GO step late in the episode (trials ~60-91), strongest after an unrewarded trial
explanation: Fires only at the GO step (never at D1 or D2), and almost only late in the episode: 97% of activation mass falls in trials 50-99, peaking at trials 70-89 (rate about 5% vs 1.25% overall), with nothing before trial 20 and a drop-off after trial 90. The large activations (top quartile, up to about 1.0) are at GO right after an unrewarded trial (prev_reward 0 holds 82% of mass and 96% of the top quartile), often while choosing a1. The weak activations (about 0.01 to 0.07) sit on long runs of rewarded a2 choices where the policy strongly favours a2 (choice logit < -8.9). Never fires when in_rew = 1 at the step itself, or at D1/D2. A pure time window (GO, trials 70-89) gets recall 0.81 but precision 0.14; the recorded predicate (GO, trials 60-91, previous trial unrewarded OR strong a2 preference) gets mass recall 0.83 on dev, but precision stays near 0.16 because inside that window the feature fires on only a small, unpredictable subset of GO steps. It looks like an episode-clock signal gated at GO, and its magnitude is driven by an unrewarded previous trial. Uses only observed variables (episode time, previous reward, the model own policy logit).
